adaptation_rules: below 70% on a stage check: redo fundamentals of that stage before advancing
two clean stage checks: skip repeated drills of the same type
fatigue day: replace drills with question-path review only
daily_tasks: evening 1-2: single-table drills 30 min plus 15 min recall
evening 4: join exercises plus weekly self-check

likely_misconceptions: GROUP BY returns one row per table

question_path: What does one result row represent here?
Which table does each column come from?
What happens to rows without a match?
self_assessment: explain GROUP BY output row meaning in one sentence
predict join result size before executing
redo one failed exercise from memory a week later

stages.practice: rewrite 5 given queries on a sample table
stages.self_check: solve 8 of 10 filter tasks without notes

stages.practice: build 3 summary queries on the sample database
combine orders and customers in 4 exercises
